svg.title: An eval set scores the same cases before and after a change
svg.desc: Twenty fixed real inputs, each with a pass rule, scored in four runs. Three runs of the same prompt pass 14, 13, and 15 of 20: the spread is noise from sampling. After one prompt change the set passes 17 of 20, above the noise range. A number line marks the noise band from 13 to 15 and the new score at 17. Illustrative numbers.
svg.text: SAME 20 CASES, EACH WITH A PASS RULE
A change counts only if it moves the score past the noise.
